values.summary: Tested the non-authoritative v3 sprint readiness route against the live V3-H sprint umbrella and child issue denominator, repaired the parser for the current umbrella body shape, and retained typed v2 as the only operational authority before #505 cutover.
actual_changes: Added v3 sprint membership parsing support for the live `## Child issues` umbrella section used by #625.
Added support for numbered child issue rows such as `1. #627` while preserving the existing bullet-row parser path.
Added a regression test proving the V3-H child issue heading, numbered rows, membership version, and readiness status are parsed together.
Captured typed v2 issue readbacks for #625 and child issues #627 through #632 as repo-local evidence for the v3 sprint readiness canary.
Used the typed v2 GitHub issue owner to add `Membership version: 1` to #625 after the v3 canary exposed the missing sprint membership-version defect.

Recorded the v3 sprint readiness report showing `read_only: true`, `operational_authority: false`, `status: ready`, declared children #627 through #632, closed children #627 and #628, and open children #629 through #632.

actual_validation.purpose: Reject Rust formatting drift after the v3 sprint parser repair.
Prove the sprint-readiness parser rejects escaping evidence, rejects missing child readbacks, preserves existing live membership parsing, and accepts the V3-H `## Child issues` numbered-list shape.
Verify the one-binary command manifest and cutover-boundary tests remain green after adding the sprint parser regression.
Verify real-issue v3 canaries still pass after adding live sprint-readiness evidence.
Run the complete C-SDLC v3 test suite after the sprint-readiness parser repair.
Prove #505 authority-transition gates and v2-live boundary still hold after the v3 sprint-readiness canary work.
Verify whitespace hygiene for the current #505 worktree diff before lifecycle reconciliation.
Verify typed C-SDLC v2 issue state before recovering stale review/publication truth for this new slice.
